description: This file defines the NotANumberException class, a specific exception used in the Apache Commons Math library to signify that a value is not a number (NaN). It extends MathIllegalNumberException and uses localized formats for messaging.

classes.name: NotANumberException
classes.description: A specific exception thrown when a value is not a number (NaN), extending MathIllegalNumberException to provide detailed messaging.

methods.name: NotANumberException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a localized message indicating NaN is not allowed.
